consent_rules_months.name: consent_rules_months
consent_rules_months.value: ("consent_rules"."rule" = 'months' and "consent_rules"."months" between 1 and 120) or ("consent_rules"."rule" <> 'months' and "consent_rules"."months" is null)

package_session_events_rules.name: package_session_events_rules
package_session_events_rules.value: ("package_session_events"."kind" = 'deduction' and "package_session_events"."delta" = 1 and "package_session_events"."appointment_id" is not null) or ("package_session_events"."kind" = 'override' and length(btrim(coalesce("package_session_events"."reason", ''))) >= 3)

schedule_exceptions_kind.name: schedule_exceptions_kind
schedule_exceptions_kind.value: ("schedule_exceptions"."kind" = 'off' and "schedule_exceptions"."branch_id" is null and "schedule_exceptions"."start_time" is null and "schedule_exceptions"."end_time" is null) or ("schedule_exceptions"."kind" = 'hours' and "schedule_exceptions"."branch_id" is not null and "schedule_exceptions"."start_time" < "schedule_exceptions"."end_time")

staff_schedules_break.name: staff_schedules_break
staff_schedules_break.value: ("staff_schedules"."break_start" is null and "staff_schedules"."break_end" is null) or ("staff_schedules"."break_start" < "staff_schedules"."break_end" and "staff_schedules"."break_start" >= "staff_schedules"."start_time" and "staff_schedules"."break_end" <= "staff_schedules"."end_time")

visit_checkouts_amounts.name: visit_checkouts_amounts
visit_checkouts_amounts.value: "visit_checkouts"."due_halalas" >= 0 and "visit_checkouts"."paid_halalas" >= 0 and ("visit_checkouts"."paid_halalas" = 0 or "visit_checkouts"."method" is not null)
